releaseNotes: Added Debts (Lent & Borrowed) screen in the Left Navigation Drawer with Active / Closed sub-tabs, To Receive & To Pay summary strip, optional initial ledger linking, partial/full Record Repayment settlement flow, and single-layer management sheet.

Added Savings Goals inside Budgets & Goals (Budgets | Goals | Planned) and on Home's Budgets & Goals tab, with Active / Paused / Reached filters, progress bars, custom icons/accents, Pause/Resume controls, and quick + Add Funds contributions.

Added Shopping Lists screen in the Left Navigation Drawer with checklist progress cards, quick-add item + estimated price bar, strike-through checked grouping, and one-tap Log as Expense conversion with itemized notes into your ledger (Room v3).
